Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for taking this with us. As we move to finalize the MSA + order form for our pilot, Procurement wanted a concise playbook that explains how Redwood handles: SOC 2 evidence, pen test scheduling, what audit rights look like in practice (inspection windows, sampling cadence), and the list of internal contacts who will own evidence delivery.

We have two asks to keep the timeline moving:
- A one-page playbook our security team can use to triage evidence requests and pen test notices.
- A proposed evidence-owner matrix (who owns what artifact and expected SLA for response).

Can you circulate a draft by end-of-week so our legal and security can review alongside the redlines we received? I attached the current HealthCo MSA redlines for reference.

Maria

Stephanie / Maria —

I reviewed HealthCo's PDF redlines and sketched a recommended path for the MSA/Order Form:

High-level positions to take:
- SOC 2: Accept assertion mapping language but limit to vendor-provided artifacts (i.e., system-level reports and SOC 2 common criteria coverage). Push back on language that requires continuous or on-demand full-scope inspections without agreed notice or sampling.
- Pen test: Agree to allow customer-conducted pen tests with a mutually agreed 30-day notice + scope approval; we should include a staging-only option for production-impacting tests and an optional NDAs/Rules of Engagement addendum.
- Audit rights: Propose an "inspection-lite" approach — 2 inspection days per rolling 12 months with a sampling cadence (e.g., up to 5 sampled artifacts per inspection) unless a material incident triggers an expanded review. This balances customer assurance and operational burden.

I attached a redline PDF with inline comments and a short draft paragraph to add to the Order Form that captures the inspection-lite approach. Laura, please review for commercial/legal acceptability; Ben / Stephanie, adjust the playbook language to match this framing.

Karthik Iyer
Associate General Counsel, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — quick commercial notes from the sales side:
- Timeline: HealthCo needs to sign by 06/11 to make the Q2 pilot start. That gives us two weeks after the playbook to resolve redlines.
- Rollout: If legal/legal-comms agree, propose we include a one-off onboarding credit if they accept the inspection-lite approach and limit pen-test windows to staging by default. That usually helps close.

Operational ask for the matrix: Stephanie / Maria, can we map artifacts to owners at the role level (e.g., \"SOC 2 report\" -> Compliance (Redwood) -> 5 business days)? That will make it easier for procurement to sign off.

Maria —

Attached are the deliverables we discussed:

- evidence-owners-matrix.csv (artifact -> owner role -> target SLA)

Summary of key positions:

- SOC 2: We will provide latest SOC 2 Type II report and relevant system-level artifacts on a 5-business-day SLA for standard requests.

- Redwood legal: finalize Order Form paragraph if HealthCo agrees to inspection-lite (Karthik / Laura) — due 2026-06-04.
- Evidence mapping: accept or propose changes to owners and SLAs in evidence-owners-matrix.csv (Maria / Security Ops) — due 2026-06-02.

If you prefer a short sync instead of back-and-forth, Ben and I can set a 30-minute call on Monday 06/01.

Thanks —
